clues.text: After parting from Abram, Lot settled in the cities of the plain and pitched his tent toward this city.
Abraham pleaded with the LORD to spare this city if only ten righteous people could be found there.
Two angels arrived here in the evening and found Lot sitting in the city gateway.
The LORD rained down sulfur and fire from the heavens on this city and its neighbor.
Four invading kings seized its goods and carried off Abram's nephew Lot, who was living there.
Through Ezekiel, God called this city Jerusalem's younger sister, arrogant and overfed, who ignored the poor and needy.
Jesus told Capernaum that this city would have remained to this day if it had seen His miracles.
